Intro: About too many things. I looked death in the eyes that day, and realized I was nothing special.
My brother would have died that day if that man didn't distract that pale monster. Sister Ana told us you knew him, that he went by Goran.
I wanted to say…I'm sorry, Chef. I thought-I really believed that I could finally put in an end to hurting those around me. But it never works.
Success: Oh…why can I still taste? I–I…I thought I wasn't normal anymore. That I…that I would have to leave everyone. But now…thank you chef.
Fail: Ha…haha. I can't even taste your food anymore. I'm sorry, Chef. But it seems I'm spoiled to the core. I should go before anyone else gets hurt.
Reject: Huh? Chef? What are you talking about? Please—just please let me go! I have had enough!
